description: This file defines the LocalCache class, a singleton that manages local data storage using SQLite via the sqflite package. It provides methods for initializing the database, setting key/value pairs, and retrieving values, primarily used for caching tokens and recent transaction data in a finance tracking app.

classes.name: LocalCache
classes.description: Singleton class providing a local SQLite-based cache, storing key-value pairs and recent transactions for the finance tracker app.

methods.name: database
methods.description: Asynchronously initializes and returns the singleton database instance, creating tables if necessary.

methods.name: setKv
methods.description: Stores a key-value pair into the 'kv' table, replacing existing entries if the key already exists.

methods.name: getKv
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a key from the 'kv' table, or returns null if not found.
